firstPlayerRule: The player who won the last game starts, or choose whoever makes the best Chupacabra noise.
clarifications: Everyone rolls their dice simultaneously at the start of a round. The first player then attacks or passes, followed by the player to their left.
Each later round begins with the player to the left of whoever began the previous round.

internalEvidence: The Steve Jackson Games PDF linked from its Chupacabra product page was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 120515. Both pages were rendered and visually checked. Page 1 offers the previous-game winner or best Chupacabra noise as the initial starter; all players roll simultaneously, then attacks or passes proceed left from the first player. A later round begins left of the previous round's starter. Page 2 identifies Steve Jackson Games rules version 2.1 (September 2023). Official PDF SHA-256: cad8a21571a413998ab7d9f9b0681637b4995e2e1a74c7b411603d550df8cea8. An earlier version 2.0 mirror was checked separately and gives the same opening selection. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet does not say how to resolve disagreement over the best Chupacabra noise or how to proceed if there was no previous game.
